name: OATS
author: OATS Framework
description: OATS on Omarchy: an OATS icon in the bar whose panel lists the agents waiting on you, read when you open it, and opens their sessions, the TUI and the Desktop; and a setup script for launchers, keys and an oats menu.

barWidget.description: A panel, read fresh each time it opens, that lists the agents waiting on you and opens their sessions, the OATS TUI and Desktop, and setup.
